theme_and_identity.concept: Premium Dynasty Fantasy Football League (LA Lega)
theme_and_identity.vibe: Professional, Authoritative, Strategic, Historic. Avoid childish app looks and generic AI gradient slop.
theme_and_identity.base_theme: Dark Mode (deep plum/midnight purple backgrounds with high-contrast text and gold/bronze accents)

typography.strategy: Editorial Future combined with Soft Utility for data

headings.usage: Page titles, hero sections, stats highlights

layouts_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped tables.
layouts_and_spacing.grid_system: Asymmetrical 'Bento' grid for Dashboard (e.g., Hero stat col-span-8, secondary col-span-4). High density grid for stats and tables.
layouts_and_spacing.borders_and_surfaces: 1px solid borders (border-[#3B1C5A]) with subtle inner glow. Soft UI rounded corners (rounded-xl to rounded-2xl).
layouts_and_spacing.mobile_responsive: Strict mobile-first. Ensure horizontal scroll or stacked cards for complex financial tables on mobile.

components.navigation: Sticky top nav. MUST have solid or heavy blur background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0D0514]/80 border-b border-[#3B1C5A]). NEVER transparent over content.
components.cards: Flat background with 1px border. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and glow shadow. For stats: use grid borders (border-collapse look).
components.buttons: Primary: Pill-shaped, Deep Purple bg with Gold/White text. Hover: Lighter purple. Secondary: Outline with heavy border.
components.tables: Shadcn tables but with generous cell padding (p-4) and JetBrains Mono for numbers. Hover states on rows.
components.forms: Shadcn inputs. Solid dark backgrounds for inputs with strong focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37]).

interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform) with duration-200. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
interactions_and_motion.micro_animations: Framer Motion for page entrances (fade in up), staggered list items, and modal pops.
interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background AND text color. High contrast on active/focus.

pages_strategy.Login: Editorial split screen. Left: Dark moody stadium background with heavy purple overlay. Right: Clean, crisp login form. JWT logic setup.
pages_strategy.Dashboard_Squadra: Bento grid. Top: Financial Summary (Budgets, Salaries). Middle: Monthly roster management (drag/drop or select UI). Bottom: Upcoming contract expiries.
pages_strategy.Mercato_Offerte: Split view or tabs. Left: Chat/Negotiation history. Right: Offer form with dynamic clauses (Shadcn forms).
pages_strategy.Bacheca: Social feed style. Cards for official communications from the 8 teams. Focus on typography and reading experience.
pages_strategy.Albo_D_Oro: Prestigious museum vibe. Large gold typography, dark backgrounds, high-contrast imagery.
pages_strategy.Statistiche: Dense data view. Charts (Recharts/Shadcn Charts), historical tables, top scorer rankings. Professional financial tool feel.
pages_strategy.Pannello_Presidente: Admin dense grid. Editable tables, quick toggles, overriding inputs for all teams and players.

image_urls.description: Night stadium, moody. Apply dark purple overlay.
Gold trophies. Use for Hall of Fame header.
Soccer ball on field. Use for generic team/market headers.
Purple abstract texture. Use as card backgrounds or header accents.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility_and_testing.focus: All buttons and links must have distinct focus rings.
